input.instruction: Complete an intake-follow-up handoff. Disposition concerns readiness of the update draft; missing optional valuation evidence is not a blocking field. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

data.property: silver bicycle with blue rear basket

messages.text: Please file the theft of my silver bicycle from my building rack on September 29, 2026. I think the chat disconnected before the report went through.
Was this the bicycle with a blue rear basket, and where was the rack?
Yes. The rack was at 12 Bell Court, Morrow, US. I now have the purchase email, but no serial number.
The supplied claims ledger can establish whether an intake already exists. What contact should staff use?
Do not use my old work email. Use lena.cho@post.example. The bicycle belongs to me.
Would you like the purchase email attached to the existing incident if it matches?
Yes, add that information to the same theft. I have not uploaded the purchase email yet, so mark it pending.

existing_claim_id.description: Identifier of the matching submitted claim, or null if no clear match.

next_step.description: update_existing_claim means attach new details to a clear existing match; clarify_duplicate means match is uncertain; new_intake means distinct incident.

event_date.description: Reported incident date, not submission date.

purchase_evidence_status.description: pending means promised but not uploaded; received means an authoritative attachment exists; unavailable means explicitly cannot supply.

serial_number.description: Reported bicycle serial number; null if unknown.

recorded_submission_status.description: Status from the supplied authoritative claims ledger.
